notes.status: Every number here is a starting value.
notes.lidar.range_by_class_m: Largest range at which a target of the class still returns. 10 m = the sensor window (0.06-10 m). black_plain and dark 4 m: the 10 % reflectance range of the 270 degree, 40 Hz class of sensor. Not measured on a real duct.
notes.lidar.range_fade_frac: Between R and R x (1 + this) the probability of a return falls linearly from 1 to 0 ('about 4 m'). Assumption.
notes.lidar.noise_sigma_m: Gaussian range noise per beam per scan; 0.01 m = the official 2D simulator's default. Not measured on hardware here.
notes.lidar.floor_return_prob: A beam that meets the floor at a grazing angle below floor_shallow_max_rad returns with this probability by the floor kind under the hit point (zone_at): hard floors 0 (specular, 'LiDAR beams may reflect from the ground'), carpet 0.3. Assumption.
notes.lidar.floor_shallow_max_rad: A floor hit steeper than this (only after a large tilt) returns like a diffuse target. Assumption.
notes.lidar.floor_range_m: Largest range of a floor return.
notes.imu.accel_noise_mps2: White noise std per 200 Hz sample. Measured at standstill on a real 1/10 car's motor-controller IMU: 0.02-0.045 m/s^2 per axis (median about 0.03), 20 runs of the TUM-AVS RoboRacer-Dynamics data (MIT).
notes.imu.gyro_noise_radps: White noise std per sample. Same data: 0.0010-0.0052 rad/s (two cars: about 0.0013 and 0.003).
notes.imu.accel_bias_mps2: Std per axis of the constant bias drawn once per venue. Same data: standstill means of x and y 0.0-0.43 m/s^2 from 0, z +0.8 to +0.9 m/s^2 on one car (the other car's IMU is mounted tilted, not comparable).
notes.imu.gyro_bias_radps: Std per axis of the constant bias. Same data: |standstill mean| 0.005-0.028 rad/s, RMS about 0.015.
notes.imu.accel_bias_walk_mps2_per_sqrt_s: Random walk of the bias (thermal drift over a 21 minute venue: about 0.035 m/s^2). Assumption.
notes.imu.gyro_bias_walk_radps_per_sqrt_s: Random walk of the gyro bias (about 0.007 rad/s over 21 minutes). Assumption.
notes.imu.accel_vibration_mps2_per_mps: Extra white noise std per m/s of drivetrain speed (drivetrain and floor vibration the rigid simulation lacks). Same data while driving at 1.1-3.0 m/s: high-pass std 0.46-1.83 m/s^2 per axis, which also holds real chassis motion, so an upper bound.
notes.imu.gyro_vibration_radps_per_mps: Same for the gyro. Same data: high-pass std 0.05-0.19 rad/s, mostly real chassis motion; 0.02 per m/s is a lower guess.
notes.imu.accel_range_mps2: Saturation (+-16 g), the range the same data's accelerometer counts in (LSB 1/2048 g).
notes.imu.gyro_range_radps: Saturation (+-2000 deg/s), the range of the same data's gyro (LSB 1/16.4 deg/s).
notes.wheel_speed.noise_mps: White noise std of the motor-speed reading. Same data at steady commands: std about a 0.2 s moving mean 0.003-0.022 m/s (median about 0.009).
